messages:
Aisha Rahman: anyone else seeing customer reports of OpenAI-compat streaming just stopping mid-response (no [DONE])? OrchidCRM pinged me w/ 2 examples in eu-west.

Ben Carter: weve had at least one other customer mention truncated SSE this week (AsterixPay). might be same thing.

Soojin Lee: can you drop the request ids? also were they using the OpenAI SDK or raw?

Aisha Rahman: OpenAI python SDK. request ids: req_7c2bXXXX and req_aa19XXXX. they say HTTP 200 but stream ends early.

Dev Patel: yep matches SUP-2481. can we open a separate ticket for OrchidCRM so we can track comms + impact?

Aisha Rahman: will do. also they asked if theres a recommended retry strategy to avoid double-billing.

Dev Patel: for now: retry only when missing [DONE] and include idempotency key if they can. longer-term well add server heartbeats.

Incident Bot: :eyes: created incident placeholder INC-2025-02-13-STREAM for monitoring stream disconnects (eu-west).
